common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D Unity BOSS CHARACTER BODY animation sheet.
REFERENCE ROLE: attached level8.png is the EXACT identity, anatomy, feather silhouette, palette, black outline weight and cel-shaded style reference. It is JIUYAO XUANHUANG, a majestic NON-HUMANOID star phoenix. Silver-white head/breast and slender curved S-neck, short hooked BLACK beak, fierce RED eyes. EXACTLY THREE long swept silver/ivory crest plumes. Deep navy/cobalt wing and body plumage with layered icy-CYAN feather edges. TWO feathered WINGS, TWO powerful dark scaled BIRD legs and silver talons; NO arms, hands, human skin, armor, tools or weapons. Huge attached navy/cyan fan tail as reference: SIX large cyan-ring medallions, each containing one FOUR-POINT cyan star, distributed over the long paired fan feathers. One corresponding cyan star-eye marking at each outer wing panel. Preserve the same tail feather shape, ring/star count and crest design in all16 poses; all wing/tail tips and markings fully drawn. Do not turn this into a humanoid bird soldier, peacock with a human face, dragon or ordinary eagle.
EXACTLY16 separate FULL phoenix figures, FOUR columns x FOUR rows, PORTRAIT1024x1536 RGBA PNG, invisible equal256x384 cells. Chronological row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom, including row transitions. ALL FOUR ROWS must contain4 complete birds: row1F1-4,row2F5-8,row3F9-12,row4F13-16. Never stop at12figures or leave a blank fourth row.
COMPOSITION CRITICAL: draw the whole bird TINY inside each cell. Entire body plus COMPLETE spread wings and HUGE full tail fan should be approximately120-150px wide x160-220px tall. Absolute maximum178px width/288px height (70%/75%). Prefer at least50px transparent side margins and60px vertical margins, NEVER less than32px horizontal or40px vertical. The sheet must be mostly EMPTY TRANSPARENT space. Make WHOLE bird smaller to fit wide wings/tail, do not shorten/crop appendages, omit stars or fill cells. No touching/overlapping neighbors or outside canvas edge.
ONE fixed drawing scale and camera, three-quarter SCREEN LEFT facing, beak points LEFT; only the explicitly described small torso/tail turns, no camera spin or mirrored right-facing birds. Ground baseline cell-local y328, consistent body/feet center. Grounded toes touch same baseline; airborne poses rise above that SAME baseline, not a different camera or scale. Keep all jump apex crest and tail tips inside cell.
Only draw REAL CHARACTER BODY and ATTACHED feathers/embedded star markings. All SKILL VISUAL EFFECTS ARE SEPARATE assets: NO dash trails, slash arcs, energy rings, auras, loose feathers, projectiles, glints outside the body, impact flashes, dust, stone chips, afterimages, motion lines, shadows or particles in this character sheet. Embedded star color may brighten subtly but no external bloom halo.
Transparent ALPHA0 around bird and between all feather gaps. Do not copy reference's dark mist/blue backdrop glow. No background, floor/ground texture, scenery, opaque gradient, checkerboard, labels, text, numbers, grid, border, watermark or extra creatures.

F12-14 brake and pull tail back. F15-16 ready. Tail remains ATTACHED and all six medallions plus tips fully visible, no shortened/missing feathers. F12-14 LAND in deep IMPACT CROUCH, both wings spread and six-star tail fan flared, all appendages complete. F15-16 rise ready. F9-12 rise modestly, attached huge tail fan opens like reference and embedded FOUR-POINT star medallions brighten within the feathers. F13-16 HOLD airborne: BOTH wings fully spread, entire six-star fan flared like a star peacock, talons folded slightly and NO ground contact. F16 must remain AIRBORNE, do NOT return tostanding. Use smaller whole-body scale for widest wings/tail; all tips fullyinsidecell. NO aura, beam, ground shadow, sparkle, particle or loose feathers.
